objective: To send the daily orders created by DTP Creation and assigned to a truck in Planning Truck Assignment to the Driver APK of that truck (license plate).
The sync is done by a background service through the HiveMQ MQTT broker: one topic per truck plate, the Driver APK subscribes after login.
To keep the driver's list up to date: new assignment, data change, Change Truck (remove from old plate, add to new plate), Reject, and finished cycles to Riwayat Pesanan.
In case of an error the queue event is kept with status E and retried; the log shows the result of every run.

steps.text: Retrieve parameters from System Master: batch size, max attempts, schedule interval (all TBD).
children: If a parameter is missing, log message no. 4. Stop.
If the last sync log is still Processing, log message no. 2. Stop.

steps.text: Insert sync log with STATUS = 'PROCESSING', TRIGGER and START_DT; log message no. 1.
Select queue events with STATUS = 'N' (and failed events 'E' with ATTEMPT < max), ordered by QUEUE_ID, limited by batch size. Events of the same order are processed together in QUEUE_ID order.
children: If no event, log message no. 5; go to step 10.

steps.text: For each order: retrieve the Daily Order, its cycles, the active truck assignment (ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'), Truck Master, Driver Master, Location Master and the DTP record (arrival date / time).

children: Order not found / mandatory empty / truck not active: queue STATUS = 'E' with message; go to step 8.
No active assignment: STATUS = 'S' (skipped) except for remove actions; go to step 8.

steps.text: Determine the sync action per cycle with the rule table 4.3 (ADD, UPDATE, REMOVE, HISTORY).

Insert or update TB_R_DRIVER_ORDER per cycle, SYNC_VERSION + 1, and insert one outbox message per changed record (topic of PLATE_NO, JSON payload 4.6) into TB_R_DRIVER_MQ_OUTBOX, in one transaction per order.
children: On DB error, rollback the order, log message no. 14; queue STATUS = 'E', ATTEMPT + 1.

steps.text: Update queue event: STATUS = 'P' (processed) / 'S' / 'E', SYNC_ID, ERROR_MSG.
If more events remain, go back to step 4.
Background service connects to HiveMQ and publishes outbox messages with STATUS 'N' (and 'E' with ATTEMPT < max) in MSG_ID order, QoS 1.
children: Broker not reachable: log message no. 11; messages stay pending.
PUBACK received: STATUS 'S', PUBLISHED_DT; log message no. 13.
No PUBACK / error: STATUS 'E', ATTEMPT + 1; log message no. 12.

steps.text: Update sync log: STATUS SUCCESS (no error) or WARNING (some events E), counts, END_DT; log message no. 16. Unexpected error at any step: log message no. 17, STATUS ERROR. Exit.

func_desc.text: The background service (connected to the HiveMQ MQTT broker) syncs the orders that are assigned to a truck in Planning Truck Assignment into TB_R_DRIVER_ORDER, one record per cycle order, and publishes every change to the HiveMQ topic of the truck plate, so the Driver APK of the driver who logs in with that license plate receives it. It also removes the card from the old plate after Change Truck / Reject and moves finished cycles to Riwayat Pesanan. Prerequisites: DTP Creation queue processing and Planning Truck Assignment write events to TB_T_DRIVER_SYNC_QUEUE (4.1).

REMOVE for PREV_PLATE, ADD for NEW_PLATE

items: Event: the calling function inserts the queue row in its own transaction; the batch is started immediately (near real-time).

func_desc.text: Order exists in Daily Order; otherwise log message no. 6.
Active assignment exists (ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'); otherwise log message no. 7 (skipped, not an error).
Truck of the assignment exists in Truck Master with status Active; otherwise log message no. 8.
Active driver registered on the truck; otherwise log message no. 9 (record synced with empty driver).
Mandatory: ORDER_NO, CYCLE_ORDER_NO, ORDER_DT, FROM / TO location; otherwise log message no. 10.
Events of the same order are processed in QUEUE_ID order; duplicates (same order, same state) give no change (SYNC_VERSION not increased).

func_desc.text: 4.4 Driver APK use of the data (Proposed, API contract TBD)

items: Login: Username, Password, Plat Nomor Truck. The plate must be the truck registered on the driver (same rule as Daily Monitoring driver login).
After login and on [Refresh]: GET /api/driver/orders?sinceVersion=n (proposed in Truck Assignment spec) returns records of PLATE_NO with SYNC_VERSION > n, incl. REMOVE so the APK deletes cards.
Pesanan = ACTIVE_FLAG 'Y' and DISPLAY_TAB 'ORDER', sorted by ORDER_DT, ARRIVAL time. Riwayat Pesanan = DISPLAY_TAB 'HISTORY'.

After login the APK subscribes to the topic of its plate (4.6) and applies each message: ADD / UPDATE / HISTORY upsert the card, REMOVE deletes it. Messages with SYNC_VERSION <= the version already held are ignored (duplicate / out of order).
The API pull is still used for the first load after login and for [Refresh] (missed messages, reinstall).

tables.name: TB_R_DRIVER_ORDER
tables.description: Orders per cycle prepared for the Driver APK (one record per cycle order) - proposed, not in ELIPS schema
columns: No Cycle Order shown on the APK card (e.g. 260606C2PLI121)
Truck plate of the active assignment; length follows Truck Master
Active driver of the truck (Driver Master); empty if none
Driver name for the APK header
Trucking company name for the APK header
Daily order status, e.g. Order Release
Y = visible for PLATE_NO; N = removed (truck changed / rejected)
Last action ADD / UPDATE / REMOVE / HISTORY
Increments on every change; APK asks changes since its last version
Sync run that changed the record (traceability)

N = new, S = sent (PUBACK), E = error
